plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/staging/room-10/plate-01/candidate-1920x864.png, room-10 attempt 2, the standard 20:9 crop -- frame.json). Every rect below was read off that picture with a grid over it.
walkableNote: THE PUBLIC FLOOR, ON THE RUNNER AND IN FRONT OF IT. The stove's feet are at y 695, the chairs' at 620, the desk's at 625 and the clock's at 590; the runner's far edge is at y 650. So the band runs y 705-850 from the street door's step (x 205) to the case clock (x 1740), short of the inner door, which is Room 11's to open.

scaling.note: ROOM 10'S DEPTH, FROM THE MAN THE MASTER PAINTED. The composition master drew Thad about 372 tall with his feet at source y 762, which is 470 at y 748 in this plate's frame; along Room 5's slope (0.69 per row) that is 440 at the band's far edge and 540 at its near. The clerk stands behind his desk at y 600, at 368 on the same curve (tools/art/room10-clerk.py).

entrances.note: In by the street door, at left.
Anything else arrives by the door.

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees (ruling 32). THE TESTIMONIALS are the column of small framed letters at the left of the cluster; THE MAP WALL is the rest of it, the framed maps. THE CARPET is the runner's far stretch, behind the walk band, so a click on the floor still walks. THE RECEPTION DESK is its front, below the clerk; the clerk stands over it.

lamps.note: The oil lamp on the reception desk. A slow, low breath (invariant 9).
The stove's firebox, which is never allowed to go out (doc 54), on its own phase.

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object here is looked at on a bare click.

occlusion.note: NO PLANE MASKS THAT CAN REACH HIM: the walk band is in front of every piece of furniture; the clerk is cut at his desk top by his own posture.

props.note: Doc 05 Part Two-B, THE PROSPECTUS RACK, act 4: "The rack is empty." Room-10 operation 4 emptied the plate's rack and changed nothing else; tools/art/room10-rack.py keeps only the pixels that changed, over the rack, so in Act IV the pamphlets are bare shelves. Not a hotspot: THE PROSPECTUS RACK is.
